description: Upload a Pinterest CUSTOMER LIST from emails (or mobile ad ids) — buyers, subscribers or leads — and, by default, make the CUSTOMER_LIST audience that targets it in the same call. Every address is SHA-256 hashed on our server; no plain address reaches Pinterest. Pinterest must find at least 100 of them on Pinterest or the list ends TOO_SMALL and cannot deliver. READ BACK from Pinterest. 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

audienceName.description: name of the CUSTOMER_LIST audience made from this list (when createAudience is on)

emails.description: email addresses to upload; hashed on our server before sending

listType.description: IDFA or MAID for mobile ids; ignored when emails are sent (list becomes EMAIL)

maids.description: mobile ad ids to upload; hashed on our server before sending

name: create_pinterest_ads_customer_list
title: Upload a Pinterest customer list
